title: NOTAM evidence is narrow, lexical and non-operational
summary: CivicPort v0.14 supports only faa.swim.aim-fns.notam-runway-closure/0.1 above already-durable SWIM simpleText. It retains unsupported/malformed evidence as diagnostics and exposes read-only SQL/Runtime evidence surfaces while refusing operational interpretation.
invariants: Accepted grammar is the exact seven-token domestic runway closure shape !<accountable> <NN/NNN> <location> RWY <designator> CLSD <start>-<end>.
YYMMDDHHMM, EST and PERM remain lexical source tokens; no DateTime, century, timezone or current-active inference is allowed.
Taxiway notices, non-CLSD conditions, extra clauses and malformed shapes fail closed.
CivicNotamJournalProjector retains unsupported/malformed records as explicit diagnostics instead of dropping them.
civic_notam_runway_closure is a first-read frozen read-only snapshot.
Runtime ability civic.notam.runway-closure.evidence/0.1 accepts only source_identity.
There is no NOTAM-specific HardWorld promotion rule in v0.14.
procedure: Parse rich SWIM XML and AIM FNS simpleText before applying the narrow NOTAM adapter.
Preserve exact raw text, source XML path, queue evidence identity and lexical fields.
Route unsupported forms to projection diagnostics.
Keep SQL/Runtime surfaces evidence-only until a separately governed operational semantics project exists.

provenance.claim: v0.14 durable-journal NOTAM SQL/Runtime evidence surfaces and non-operational boundary.
Narrow fail-closed runway-closure grammar and lexical time semantics.
